title: Place value
examples: Teacher, what is the value of the seven in 725?
How do I write the number four hundred and sixty thousand?
Why do we need a zero in the number 503?

explain.say: Today we learn about place value. Place value tells us what a digit means. It depends on where the digit sits in a number.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: base-ten blocks. Can you see the thousand and the hundreds? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Look at the number twenty-three. The two is in the tens place. It means two groups of ten. So the two is worth twenty.
Next we look at hundreds. In the number three hundred five, the three is in the hundreds place. It means three groups of one hundred. So the three is worth three hundred.
We can go up to millions. In the number one million two hundred, the one is in the millions place. It means one group of one million. So the one is worth one million.

items: 1 million: one group of one million

explain.say: Zero is a very important placeholder. If we write five hundred three, the zero stands for empty tens. It keeps the three in the ones place correctly.

faq.q: What does the zero do in a number?
faq.a: The zero acts like a placeholder. It shows that a certain place value, like tens or hundreds, is empty. It keeps the value of other digits correct.
asks: Why do we use zero in numbers?
What is the job of zero in place value?

faq.q: How do I write a large number like five million?
faq.a: You write the number five followed by six zeros. This means five groups of one million. You are writing five million.
asks: What is the number five million?
How many zeros are in five million?

faq.q: If I see a number like 409, what is the zero doing?
faq.a: The zero is in the tens place. It tells us that there are zero tens. So we only have four hundreds and nine ones.
asks: What does the zero mean in 409?

faq.q: Can I just say the number without using place value names?
faq.a: You can say it in words, but understanding place value helps you know the actual value. It helps you compare and add bigger numbers.
asks: Should I learn place value or just count?
Is place value just for writing numbers?

faq.q: What is the biggest place value we learned?
faq.a: We learned about the millions place value. This means we are counting in groups of one million. It is a very large number.
asks: What is the highest place value?

facts: The place values go up: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, millions.
A zero is used when a place value is empty, like in 702.
The digit in the millions place represents millions of items.
Partitioning means breaking a number into its place value parts.

quiz.say: What is the value of the 4 in 4,000,000?
quiz.why: The 4 is in the millions place, so it is worth four million.

wrong.1: This mistake is tempting because the 4 is before the first comma.
wrong.2: This mistake is tempting because the digit itself is four.
wrong.3: This mistake is tempting because you might count the zeros as groups of ten.

quiz.say: What is the correct partitioning of 605?
quiz.why: The zero in the tens place means there are zero tens, so we write zero tens.

wrong.1: This mistake is tempting because you forget to mention the tens place.
wrong.2: This mistake is tempting because you only look at the first two digits.
wrong.3: This mistake is tempting because you might think the zero means ten.

quiz.say: What number has 7 in the thousands place and 3 in the ones place?
quiz.why: The thousands place needs a zero in the hundreds and tens places to hold the 7.

wrong.0: This mistake is tempting because you are only using three digits.
wrong.2: This mistake is tempting because you only use two digits.
wrong.3: This mistake is tempting because you put the 3 in the hundreds place.
